projects.description: Implemented multi‑task real‑time control with RTOS semaphore synchronization across 6 concurrent tasks. Developed temperature‑based LED alerting with 3+ states, humidity‑driven NeoPixel RGB indicators, and LCD display with Normal/Warning/Critical modes. Built a Wi‑Fi Access Point web server for remote appliance control via a custom browser interface. Deployed a Tiny ML model on‑device for environment classification with on‑hardware accuracy evaluation. Integrated MQTT‑based cloud data publishing to Core IOT platform in Station (STA) Wi‑Fi mode.
impact_metrics: Real‑time remote control via web interface
projects.name: Smart Home Automation System

projects.description: Integrated a servo motor to automate a feeding chute mechanism for scheduled fish feeding cycles. Deployed DHT20 temperature sensor and ultrasonic sensor for continuous water temperature and level monitoring. Implemented threshold‑based control logic to trigger feeding and alerts autonomously, with real‑time status displayed on LCD.
impact_metrics: Continuous water temperature and level monitoring
projects.name: Automated Fish Farm Monitoring System

projects.description: Designed a 4‑way traffic light system with 7‑segment countdown display and Proteus simulation. Configured a 10 ms hardware timer for flicker‑free 4‑digit display and 8×8 LED matrix control. Built a 4‑mode traffic FSM with button debouncing, real‑time parameter editing, and simultaneous LED feedback. Architected a lightweight cooperative task scheduler managing 5 concurrent periodic tasks with idle‑mode power optimization. Implemented interrupt‑driven UART with ring buffer, protocol FSM parser, and ADC sensor reporting.
impact_metrics: 10 ms hardware timer for display stability
